state.goal: User requests complete can dev local runtime including R2, no manual dependencies or second app manifest. Close existing authored File upload/finalize/attachment/download workflow using same genuine APIs; no arbitrary new R2 SDK or separate cloud service. Preserve authorization, evaluation order, immutable refs, retry, State atomicity, bounded storage work and honest crash recovery. Decide implementation direction at PROPOSAL stage, not claim tested behavior.

verified_source.worker: main.ts provisions resource bindings but never installs AssemblyDeps.files. assembly.ts known /files upload routes explicitly unavailable absent binding. local-bindings.ts provisions/probes implicit FILES bucket. Thus bucket alone does not enable authored File workflows.
verified_source.producer: Files BlobStorePort, IntentStorePort, FinalizedStorePort all synchronous. Files upload/finalize functions synchronously validate received offsets, actual type and digest, retry ownership, expiry, and frozen provenance. Only durable host implementation is Node SQLite (metadata+bytes one transaction). No existing R2 adapter. Interfaces FileJourneyBindings accepts async entrypoints and createFileJourneyKernel promisifies them.
verified_source.existing_join: createCanonicalFileBinding validates finalized receiver/bytes precommit, records attachment after canonical State commit and repairs on replay. createBoundFileHandler reuses actual Interfaces upload auth+CSRF; downloads revalidate current Identity, canonical model field grant, owner State row/revision, same physical File snapshot and bytes. Its physicalFiles.get is currently synchronous at four reads and may safely become sync|async with await at same positions. Existing tests use real D1 State + NodeSQLite Files; no real R2 workflow.
verified_source.existing_env: Worker already has D1 env.DB for Identity, distinct configured State databases or root DO authority, plus implicit R2 FILES. New host may add private namespaced D1 tables without changing State schema/commit semantics. Local DO engine already exists but implicit Files namespace/class/config does not. No source-owned file retention policy/default emission was found; explicit finite receiving policy must be selected independently, never guessed as an accepted guarantee.

state.same_acceptance: All options must run actual unchanged Files validation; resume upload with exact offset/retry/context, finalize exactly one immutable ref, survive restart/lost response, reject competing stale append/finalize rather than lose bytes, preserve domain require rollback, attach postcommit/replay repair, protect reads through actual canonical grant and original owner, bound bytes by policy and DB traversal by explicit pages, and never present R2 publication as atomic with business State.
state.a: Worker-safe bounded transaction adapter over existing D1+R2: load only exact current intent/retry/linked final rows and <=policy-sized selected blobs; invoke unchanged sync producer using private per-call staging ports (not test doubles, not an unbounded whole-store snapshot); capture all writes and stable minted identities. Publish changed bytes under unique immutable R2 object keys before acceptance. Atomic D1 batch CAS token fences all metadata/retry/blob-pointer writes; stale revision reruns boundedly on a fresh snapshot. After accepted metadata, retries return same final ref; no accepted row can point at uncommitted bytes. Persist private publication/cleanup journal before touching R2; crash/orphan recovery and deletion must use exact journal+current pointer absence, bounded pages, no unsafe mutable overwrite or deletion. Safely fails if host prerequisite missing. More SQL/staging/CAS implementation but reuses existing configured bindings.
state.b: Dedicated private Files Durable Object per selected app/owner using existing Miniflare DO and SQLite, serialized method lifetime across async R2 operations. Metadata sync SQL ports plus bounded staged R2 bytes and a persisted publication journal; must publish bytes before final metadata acceptance and recover interruptions exactly like A. Reuse genuine Files producers and same canonical bindings. Need generated class export, implicit private namespace in deploy/local descriptors and RPC adapter; no new cloud provider. Avoid D1 CAS races but add hidden provisioning/actor routing and avoid claiming SQLite transaction includes R2.
state.c: Change defining Files storage ports and upload/finalize/retention functions to async (or add async canonical equivalents) and supply real D1+R2 ports. This avoids synchronous transaction-staging bridge but still requires host concurrency fencing/publication journal/ordered recovery across D1 and R2. Broad owner API/test callsite migration; can improve long-term explicitness but greater current change. Same behavior and authorization required; async by itself gives no transaction.
state.uncertainty: A and B are designs, not tested implementations. Neither may hide R2 orphan cleanup, state-retirement authority or receiving-policy decisions. Prefer direction requiring least total new mechanism while satisfying exact workflow. If a concrete unresolved requirement blocks choosing, select investigate; do not invent generalized provider/event framework or claim bucket probe qualifies workflow.

direction.instructions: For the verified current source and requested workflow, which proposed direction offers the best simplicity and correctness tradeoff?

criteria.d1_r2_adapter: Keep Files producers synchronous behind a bounded D1/R2 commit adapter with explicit CAS and recovery journal.
criteria.files_actor: Keep Files producers but own all calls in a dedicated internal DO that serializes R2 publication and metadata.
criteria.async_kernel: Make Files producers/ports async and handle publication/concurrency at that owning layer.
criteria.investigate: Do not select a direction until an actual unresolved requirement is known.
